name: caddy-site

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: no Dockerfile, CI workflow or platform manifest; the README only says to run `caddy run` (or the stock caddy image) on a machine

processes.note: Caddy serves src/ with file_server and its templates directive (HTML includes rendered by Caddy per request); /api/* is proxied to localhost:4444, a backend that is not in this repository

notBreaks.why: minified third-party browser player served as a static file; its setInterval runs in the visitor's page

notes: Read the Caddyfile, demo/Caddyfile, README.md, .github/ (only FUNDING.yml) and every .js file under src/. All JavaScript is browser code fetched by pages (fetch/$.get to /api/...); the only rule pattern in it is setInterval inside the vendored asciinema player, and the hand-written files use setTimeout only. The /api/* backend behind localhost:4444 is not in the repository, so it is neither a process nor a finding here; a move must ask where it lives. demo/Caddyfile is a separate on-demand TLS demo host (its README says it runs on its own machine) whose on-demand certificates and port 443 binding have no Cloud Run equivalent; it is left out of processes as it is not part of the site.
